sourceEvidence.finding: Severity formally includes kInfo, kNotice, kDataLoss and kError; kNotice is normal but noteworthy, explicitly not itself a bug or data loss.
Stats table output maps kNotice to the literal notice alongside info/data_loss/error.
The processor pre-emits zero rows for every global single stat, so the existence of a zero notice row does not imply that its condition occurred.

implementationReview.allowedSeverity: Exact recognized notice is now a valid severity. Zero notice values no longer manufacture an invalid-stats result.
implementationReview.nonzeroNotice: Any nonzero notice, including negative values and names without a loss/error substring, is explicitly retained as nonzeroNoticeStats and blocks quality/classification with TRACE_NOTICE_NONZERO. It is not automatically labelled as actual data loss.
implementationReview.unchangedRejections: Null/missing value, empty name, unknown severity, loss/error counters, missing readiness/end/coverage, bad process identity, and incomplete parent chain retain existing unknown handling.
implementationReview.callerBoundary: The change touches quality severity admission and notice reporting only. It does not add a caller fallback. The actual reset has parent NULL/depth0, so neither configuration_dispatch_supported nor SettingsObserver inference is authorized even when the trace stats gate is satisfied.
implementationReview.outputBoundary: The original 919bee source/archive is immutable. A revised analysis must be stored as separately labelled offline interpretation bound to the original trace and the new parser source; it is not a new device run or application pass.

testsReadOnlyReviewed: Exact seven original zero-notice rows accepted under the pinned CSV schema.
Valid notices cannot supply a missing clientTransactionExecuted ancestor.
Positive and negative nonzero values of all actual notice counters and a generic notice remain unknown.
Unknown severity including warning/uppercase NOTICE/empty remains invalid even at zero.
Error/data_loss stays blocking alongside normal notice rows.
versionBoundary: Actual tracing service reports Perfetto v54.0 (N/A); the stats table and severity strings here are produced by independently pinned trace_processor v59.1. The cited v59.1 stats source explains the processor schema, not the device binary.
